title: 阿龍是誰
mood: laid-back jealousy that boils over, then melts
subject: a girlfriend's grey parrot that bites only him and greets him with her ex-boyfriend's name
caption: Mandarin reggae-rock in the style of the Nanning band Mr Chelonian. A clean electric guitar skank, a muted upstroke chop on two and four; a melodic dub-style bass line wandering under the verses; an organ bubble on the offbeats; spring reverb and delay throws on the snare and the skank; distorted rock power chords crashing in for every chorus. Drums play a one-drop groove in the verses, kick and rimshot on three, and switch to a straight rock beat in the choruses. Warm, humid and roomy, the bass forward in the verses and the guitars wide in the choruses. Male voice, a warm, slightly raspy baritone, laid-back and conversational in the verses, breaking into a shouted rock chorus. 84 BPM, A minor. Laid-back jealousy that boils over, then melts. No dancehall riddim, no Jamaican patois, no trap drums, no EDM synths, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, skank guitar, organ bubble, one dub bass note]

[Verse 1]
她家陽台 掛著一個竹子編的鳥籠
裡面那隻灰鸚鵡 她養得比我們在一起還久
我拿香蕉給牠 牠咬我的手指
我一進門 牠就喊 阿龍你回來啦

[Pre-Chorus]
我問她 阿龍是誰
她說 一個朋友 低頭繼續剝她的橘子

[Chorus - distorted guitars, shouted]
阿龍是誰
為什麼牠一看到我 就喊阿龍
阿龍是誰
我腳上這雙拖鞋 是不是他的

[Verse 2]
後來我每天下班 帶一顆葡萄給牠
第二十一天 牠沒咬我 跳到我的肩膀上
牠在我耳邊 很小聲地說了兩個字
不是阿龍 是我的名字

[Pre-Chorus]
她從廚房跑出來 手上都是洗碗精
她說 我教了牠一個月 你不准笑

[Chorus - distorted guitars, shouted]
阿龍是誰
現在我一點都不想知道了
阿龍是誰
那雙拖鞋 明天我自己買一雙新的

[Outro - one-drop drums, spring reverb throws]
籠子裡那隻鸚鵡 一直喊我的名字
喊到對面樓的人 都探出頭來
